Hong Kong-listed Chow Sang Sang Group's jewellery arm 點睛品 now runs three stores in one Macau mall, the Venetian's own shop directory shows, as five outlets reported the opening on 9 November.

香港上市的周生生集團旗下珠寶品牌點睛品，已於澳門一個商場內開設第三間分店，威尼斯人官方店舖名錄顯示；五間傳媒機構於11月9日報道有關開幕消息。

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.
